title: Space Builder
tagline: Build in 3-D space — solids, points, vectors
privacy: Privacy: no sign-up and no personal details are collected; typed instructions (math text only) are kept for a few days with an anonymous visitor id — your IP address is never stored.

scope.valueless-query: This tool draws and verifies givens — it does not solve. To act on an angle, state a value: e.g. "the angle between line AC' and plane ABCD is 30", and it will be enforced or verified.
scope.cross-app: Plane geometry (circle, rectangle, rhombus, inscribed-in-circle…) is built in the 2-D tool: themathbible.com/geo-builder. A circle IN SPACE is supported here in the form "circle centered at O tangent to line AB at B".
scope.bare-solid: A pyramid or prism needs its base: e.g. "pyramid SABCD with a square base" or "right triangular prism ABC". A cube, box or tetrahedron builds without details.
scope.ui-command: Marks appear automatically from the givens — instead of asking for a mark, state the given itself: e.g. "angle D = 90".
scope.oblique-prism: A prism not stated "right" builds oblique only over the parallelogram family: parallelogram, rhombus, rectangle or square (e.g. "prism with a rhombus base"), and "the prism is right" straightens it. For any other base, state "right": e.g. "right prism with a triangle base".

load.unbuildable: The file opened, but no step could be rebuilt in this version ({{count}} steps) — it may have been saved by a newer build. The steps are kept exactly as saved.
load.partial: The file opened, but {{count}} step(s) could not be rebuilt (step {{steps}}) — they are flagged in the list. The steps are kept exactly as saved.
